quality_guards: Demolition risk depends on structural form, sequence, temporary support, site boundary, adjacent property, plant, competence and supervision.
Excavation risk depends on soil and water conditions, depth, support, nearby structures, services, plant movements, weather and inspection quality.
Fire and explosion risk depends on substance properties, quantity, containment, ventilation, ignition sources, process conditions, equipment and emergency controls.
MERS risk depends on destination, hospital or camel exposure, timing, symptoms, immune status, infection-control practice and diagnostic evidence.
Avian-influenza risk depends on viral subtype, animal species, exposure intensity, PPE, symptoms, antiviral timing, host factors and local epidemiology.
Enteric-fever risk depends on destination, sanitation, food and water exposure, organism, symptoms, antimicrobial resistance, occupation and clearance status.
Shigellosis risk depends on species, travel, sanitation, food and water, sexual exposure, hygiene, antimicrobial resistance and host factors.
Firework risk depends on product category, compliance, storage, site dimensions, safety distance, user behaviour, spectators, weather and disposal.
Lithium-battery aviation risk depends on chemistry, capacity, manufacturing compliance, damage, packaging, declaration, stowage, detection and crew response.
Rail-vehicle maintenance risk depends on vehicle type, duty, degradation, maintenance plan, competence, depot equipment, monitoring and return-to-service assurance.
Each family is context-specific and is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
